import sys, struct, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
from harness import *
import zstandard as zstd

ok = True
L = lease('home', '2001:db8:1:1200::/56', 0, 100, (0,), 2)
T1 = '2001:db8:1:1200::1'
S = {'web': 'tcp'}
GOOD = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]

def cap(data, encoding='zstd'):
    return {'encoding': encoding, 'chunks': [b64(data)]}

# hand-built frame headers
def frame(descriptor, window, extra=b''):
    return b'\x28\xb5\x2f\xfd' + bytes([descriptor]) + bytes([window]) + extra

# declared window beyond 128 MiB
big_window = frame(0x00, 0xA0)
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap(big_window)]))
ok &= check('huge window', got, {'error': 'capture'})

# dictionary id present
dictionary = b'\x28\xb5\x2f\xfd' + bytes([0x03]) + bytes([0x00]) + b'\x01\x00\x00\x00'
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap(dictionary)]))
ok &= check('dictionary frame', got, {'error': 'capture'})

# reserved block type
reserved = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(rows_to_csv(GOOD).encode())
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap(reserved[:6] + b'\x07\x00\x00')]))
ok &= check('reserved block', got, {'error': 'capture'})

# decompressed budget: highly compressible stream beyond 128 MiB
huge = zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(b'a' * (140 * 1024 * 1024))
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap(huge)]))
ok &= check('decompressed budget', got, {'error': 'capture'})

# 32 MiB decoded budget across captures
blob = b'a' * (17 * 1024 * 1024)
two = [cap(zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(blob)), cap(zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(blob))]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], two))
ok &= check('decoded budget', got, {'error': 'capture'})

# chunk count limit is metadata
many = {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [''] * 1025}
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [many]))
ok &= check('chunk limit', got, {'error': 'invalid'})

# 16 captures max
seventeen = [make_capture(GOOD) for _ in range(17)]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], seventeen))
ok &= check('capture count', got, {'error': 'invalid'})

# /128 offer prefix and boundary targets
rows = [icmp('i', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i1', T1, T1, 'echo'),
        icmp('j', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', '2001:db8:1:1200::2', '2001:db8:1:1200::2', 'echo')]
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [make_capture(rows)],
                      requests=[request('r1', 10, 'home', T1),
                                request('r2', 10, 'home', '2001:db8:1:1200::2')],
                      offers=[offer('o', 11, 'web', '2001:db8:1:1200::1/128', 1, 3, 'q', ['r1', 'r2']),
                              offer('p', 11, 'web', '2001:db8:1:1200::/127', 1, 9, 'q', ['r1', 'r2'])]))
ok &= check('/128 prefix', (got['plan']['resolved'], got['plan']['cost']), (2, 12))

# multiple captures each with a header
c0 = make_capture(GOOD)
c1 = make_capture([icmp('j', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '0/i2', '2001:db8:1:1200::2',
                        '2001:db8:1:1200::2', 'echo')])
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [c0, c1]))
ok &= check('two captures', got['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['internal'],
            [T1, '2001:db8:1:1200::2'])

# capture after rejected rows still fails on transport
rows = [icmp('bad', 0, 5, 'put', 'home', 3, '9/i1', T1, T1, 'echo')]
text = rows_to_csv(rows) + 'icmp,"x"y,0,5,delete,,,,,,,,\n'
got, _ = run(campaign([L], S, [10], [cap(text.encode(), 'csv')]))
ok &= check('strict after reject', got, {'error': 'capture'})

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'FAILURES')
